description.html: HabiStat Crested Gecko Diet Strawberry is a complete food for crested geckos (Correlophus ciliatus) with a refreshing strawberry flavor. The formula is designed to meet all the nutritional needs of geckos that eat a combination of fruit and insects in the wild. The product contains over 50% real fruit powder, with strawberry as the dominant flavor, which makes it very appealing even to picky eaters that refuse other flavors.

Besides its rich fruit content, the formula includes 9 different animal protein sources, providing a complete amino acid profile needed for growth, tissue repair and reproduction. The nutritional values are optimal for geckos: 23% protein, 1.95% calcium and a calcium-to-phosphorus ratio of 3.87:1. This ratio is very important because it prevents metabolic bone disease, one of the most common health problems in captive geckos. The food contains no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives.

To prepare a meal, measure about 5g of powder and mix it with a small amount of water until you reach a ketchup-like consistency. Place the prepared food in a shallow dish inside the terrarium, ideally in the evening. Serve 1 to 2 times a week and remove uneaten leftovers after 24 hours to keep the terrarium hygienic. Strawberry is a great choice for rotating with other flavors such as banana and mango, giving your gecko variety in its diet. HabiStat is a trusted British brand with decades of experience producing reptile food and equipment.
